rule: If voiceover is enabled, CTA must not be rendered as a separate on-screen CTA block.
reason: CTA is already spoken in voiceover.
check: hasVoiceover=true must suppress visual CTA overlay.

rule: Auto video voiceover must end with a spoken CTA.
reason: The auto format requires a voice-only closing CTA.
check: voiceover.text must contain voiceover.cta in the ending segment.

rule: Auto video CTA must not be present on screen or in poster text.
reason: CTA should stay voice-only for this format.
check: poster and onScreenText must not contain the CTA phrase.

rule: Auto video duration must stay within 30 seconds.
reason: The factory mode is limited to short-form output.
check: maxDurationSec and requested duration must be <= 30.

rule: Auto poster must contain a title and 2-3 facts.
reason: The poster drives the first frame and on-screen retention.
check: poster.title must exist and poster.facts length must be 2-3.

rule: Auto video text must match the selected language.
reason: Voiceover and captions must stay consistent with the chosen locale.
check: material.rules.language must equal the requested language.

rule: Auto video voiceover should sound human and conversational.
reason: The product goal is spoken, natural delivery.
check: voiceover should avoid robotic transition phrases.
